query:
SELECT j.id as journalId, j.description, j.competenceMonth, j.entryDate, j.status,
       ae.entryType, CAST(ae.amount AS DECIMAL(15,2)) as amount, ae.description as entryDesc,
       ca.code, ca.name
FROM accountingEntries ae
JOIN journals j ON ae.journalId = j.id
JOIN chartOfAccounts ca ON ae.accountId = ca.id
WHERE j.competenceMonth = '2026-01'
  AND j.status = 'POSTED'
  AND ca.code = '2.1.2.01'
ORDER BY j.entryDate, j.id
